name: Chimpin Hangout
summary:
Chimpin Hangout is a Gorilla Tag–inspired fan game focused on fun movement, exploration, and relaxed social gameplay. Swing, climb, and launch yourself around using arm-powered movement as you explore different hangout maps made for chilling and goofing off with other chimps.
